rows.en: <operator(21010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Eureka<ce()>'s a Coralian... she wasn't even human...
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Renton<ce()>... I'm sorry for hiding it...
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)>I didn't want <color(4)>Renton<ce()> to hate me...
<operator(23010,2)><speed(2)>You were different from anyone else to me from the start. <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>, you're you.
<operator(23010,2)><speed(2)>The girl I happened to fall for was a Coralian. That's all there is to it.
<operator(17010,2)><speed(2)>Yeah, none of us care about something like that!
<operator(25010,2)><speed(2)>We're a bunch of misfits to begin with. It's no big deal.
<operator(23020,2)><speed(2)>Everyone... thank you.
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Renton<ce()>... um.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>What?
<operator(23020,2)><speed(2)>I want to be with <color(4)>Renton<ce()>. Forever, forever!
<operator(23010,2)><speed(2)>Yeah, but there's still something we have to do. Let's go, <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>!
<operator(23020,2)><speed(2)>Yeah!
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, are you all right now?
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Sorry to worry you. I'm fine now.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>I'll... fight this through to the end.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Looks like you've grown. Maybe thanks to <color(4)>Faye<ce()>?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>I didn't do anything. <color(4)>Barrel<ce()> worked it out himself.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()> surely won't waver again.
<operator(23100,1)><speed(2)>Still, that's awful. <color(5)>Dewey<ce()>, I mean.
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)>...
rows.notes: Source row is an ellipsis only; rendered per brief.

rows.en: <operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>With <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> being a Coralian, we could still talk like this and understand each other.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>There's no reason to destroy the Scub Coral!
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>That's why we're the ones stopping it. What <color(5)>Dewey<ce()>'s doing...
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Brother... I will stop you, no matter what...
rows.notes: Holland addressing Dewey (off-screen), his older brother per glossary.

rows.en: <operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>To think they'd artificially bring out an <color(5)>Antibody Coralian<ce()>.
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>Actually going through with something like that, they can't be sane.
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>Those who hold power show twisted thinking...
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>Those with power going out of control -- same in every world, huh...
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>Flip side is, even across different worlds, people are the same and can understand each other. Like you and me.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>...Aren't you steering this somewhere weird?
<operator(17030,2)><speed(2)>Ohh... tough crowd.
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>Gotta crush punks like that. Right, <color(4)>Hikaru<ce()>?
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>Goes without saying. Let's hurry and get out there.
rows.notes: Source has Hikaru address Focker as 'senpai'; dropped per convention of dropping honorifics with no English equivalent.

rows.en: <operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>Heh... look who's got some mouth now.
<operator(19040,1)><speed(2)>Seems some interesting guy showed up on Earth while we were gone.
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>Don't let your guard down, <color(4)>Ryoma<ce()>. He won't be easy to deal with.
<operator(19040,1)><speed(2)>I know that.
<operator(16040,1)><speed(2)>How awful... this happens in the surface world...
<operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>Different world or not, I can't forgive this... I'll stop it with <color(4)>Nanajin<ce()>, no matter what!
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Akito<ce()>, was that okay? Leaving her behind to come here.
<operator(12011,1)><speed(2)>It's fine.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Akito<ce()>... I hope you two can meet again soon.
<operator(12011,1)><speed(2)>For now, I fight alongside these comrades. That's all.

uncertainties.issue: 'That interesting guy' Ryoma refers to is not named in this scene or resolvable from it; identity left unspecified as in the source.

checked_decisions: table1 slot99 Holland's 'Brother... I will stop you, no matter what...' addressed to Dewey (off-screen): confirmed by glossary (Dewey is Holland's older brother). No change.
table1 slot220 Hikaru's line drops his 'senpai' address to Focker per convention of dropping honorifics with no English equivalent, per existing note. No change.
table1 slot60 ellipsis-only row ('……。'): rendered as bare '...' per existing note; left unchanged.

j/q rewording (mechanical, not a meaning change): table0 slot22 'you're just you'->'you're you', reworded to remove lowercase j per project rule; meaning unaffected. 'Nanajin' (table1 slot300) left unchanged as a locked glossary unit name despite containing a lowercase j.
